newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin stable, no date yet for hospital departure.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin stable, no date yet for hospital departure.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin is in a stable condition and his temperature is normal, spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky said on Monday. He declined to say when Yeltsin, who is suffering from pneumonia, would leave hospital.
"In the doctors' opinion, the president is in a stable condition. His temperature and other indicators are in the normal range," Yastrzhembsky told a news briefing.
